Each new tile has order 3*m with m dividing 110880 and quotient 110880/m invertible modulo 3, so every compatible intersection is one exact three-point affine line over F3.

Refuse qualification unless it reproduces the frozen nine-tile shift vector.
method.stopping_rule: After this declaration is committed, run the producer once and the independently implemented source-first checker once. Retain the lift only if the checker reconstructs the frozen source, both rooted predecessors, the complete 69-tile family, all 110,649,369,600 period-332640 point outcomes, exact fractions, and canonical 545-byte nested residual records.
